title: Mother Holding Baby at Scenic Overlook, 1920s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A 1920s black and white snapshot showing a mother in a cloche hat and summer dress holding a baby next to a stone pedestal or sundial at a scenic overlook. Another young child peeks out from behind the pedestal on the left. The background reveals a wide landscape view typical of scenic road trip destinations in the Roaring Twenties.
